name: GPU Voxel Mesh Generation
aliases: Voxel Mesh Generation (Marching Cubes-like Surface Extraction)
definition: A technique to generate a cubic voxel chunk mesh entirely on the GPU using compute shaders and draw it via indirect procedural drawing, avoiding CPU readback.
summary: GPU Voxel Mesh Generation is a high-performance technique that generates static triangle meshes from 3D voxel grids entirely on the GPU using compute shaders, avoiding slow CPU readback.
